title: fss.reconstruction_atlas_adopted.v1
description: Complete private create-only localization-atlas candidate export using current retained camera calibration authority. report_digest is SHA-256 of the exact compact UTF-8 report object bytes, without recanonicalization. The manifest string contains full adopted calibration, source, query/selection and native geometry provenance; validate its decoded JSON separately. FSATLAS1 remains unchanged and bounds archive bytes to 8 MiB; the complete final JSON including newline is bounded to 32 MiB. All original sources/current privacy and current adoption/withdrawal are revalidated before publication under the held deployment owner. No calibration, twin, identity or source access is activated. Output I/O failures can leave newly created partial files; existing files are never overwritten.

provenance_manifest_utf8.description: Exact original UTF-8 provenance manifest. SHA-256 of these UTF-8 bytes equals archive.provenance_digest and the unchanged FSATLAS1 provenance pin. Validate decoded JSON against reconstruction_atlas_adopted_provenance.v1.json; contentSchema is annotation-only in some validators. Whitespace/key-order changes change the digest.
